name: Manel Kape

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (65 in height, 68 in reach, Southpaw); 126 lb at the UFC Vegas 112 and Vegas 119 weigh-ins (Dec 2025, Jun 2026; non-title flyweight limit)

photo_coverage: Adequate. 9 photos: current studio headshot and two full-body cutouts (Dec 2025, Jun 2026), a high-resolution frontal weigh-in shot (Jul 2024), a right profile and a three-quarter from his last fight (Jun 20, 2026). Commons has three older freely licensed shots (2017 CC BY 3.0 three-quarter, 2018 CC BY 3.0 weigh-in) plus a 2024 composite whose CC BY-SA claim looks doubtful (kept reference-only). No left profile, no calm three-quarter from 2026.

face.shape: Long oval face with a tall, rounded forehead; broad at the cheekbones, then hidden by the beard below; the head is long from crown to chin.
face.jaw: Medium-wide under the beard; the beard squares off the lower outline.
face.chin: Moderate and slightly rounded under the beard; does not jut.
face.cheekbones: Broad and fairly prominent, with firm flat cheeks.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate, giving the eyes a slightly deep-set look.
face.forehead: High and rounded, sloping back to the hairline; looks taller because the braids start well back. A few small bumps or spots on the forehead in the studio shots.

eyes.shape: Medium almond eyes, slightly deep-set, with a visible upper-lid crease, slight hooding at the outer corners and soft lower-lid bags

eyebrows.shape: Gently arched, slightly higher at the outer third, close to the eyes at the inner ends

nose.bridge: Low-to-medium height, broadening toward the tip
nose.tip: Broad and rounded, with wide, flared nostrils
nose.fight_damage: A small healed mark on the bridge (Jul 2024); no visible deviation.

face.mouth_lips: Medium-wide mouth with full upper and lower lips and a defined lip line; neutral to slightly pursed at rest.

ears.cauliflower_ear: No: both ears show smooth helix and antihelix (ESPN headshot zoom); a small light patch in the lower left concha.
ears.note: Slightly protruding; very visible because the sides are shaved.

face.notable_marks_scars: Small spots on the forehead; small mark on the nose bridge (2024); stud earring in the 2017 photo (not worn in fights).

hair.style: Cornrows: tight braids running from the front hairline straight back over the top in a geometric/zig-zag parting pattern, gathered into a small knot at the crown (Jun 2026 fight); sides and back shaved to the skin with a short fade line.
hair.colour_note: Black; the raw ESPN sample #3f373a includes highlights on the braids.
hair.hairline: Front hairline set fairly high and rounded; braids start just behind it
hair.texture: Tightly coiled, worn braided flat to the scalp
hair.variants: 2024: short natural hair, slightly longer on top, no braids (UFC 304 weigh-in). 2017: short high-top.

facial_hair.detail: Dense, short full beard (about 1-1.5 cm) covering the jaw, chin and lower cheeks, joined to a full moustache; clean cheek line set fairly low; a few grey hairs at the chin edges in 2026.
facial_hair.colour_note: Raw chin sample #23191a; black with a few grey strands.
facial_hair.shape: short boxed full beard with moustache

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the face samples marked in_average (well-lit cheeks, no specular highlight, no strong colour cast); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma-percentile pixels of its patch
skin.tone_hex_recommended_method: 60% face average + 40% torso (ESPN studio cutout, same lighting setup used for all four fighters in this batch), so one whole-body tint does not come out flash-pale
skin.undertone: Deep warm brown with a red-brown undertone; the deepest of this group.
skin.freckles_marks: Small bumps on the forehead; little visible body hair.
skin.note: Excluded: the specular forehead, the Jul 2024 weigh-in (strong orange stage cast, #783a14 / #6c3413) and the 2017 video still (orange cast). Torso and face sample about the same under the ESPN studio light.

body.build: Compact, thick-chested, muscular flyweight: 165 cm, 57 kg (126 lb) at weigh-in; looks heavier and denser than most flyweights.
body.body_fat_note: Lean but not shredded: smooth abdomen with soft-edged abs, full pecs.
body.shoulders: Broad and round with big delts
body.arms: Thick upper arms and forearms; reach 173 cm (8 cm more than his height)
body.notable: Thick neck; the broadest chest and shoulders of this group.

tattoos.description: none visible on the chest, abdomen, arms or legs (ESPN cutouts Dec 2025 and Jun 2026, RIZIN.14 2018, UFC Vegas 119)

tattoos_note: The upper back is bare in the Jun 2026 profile; the lower back is not seen.

kit.fight_shorts: White Venum shorts with a light-grey leaf/feather pattern and a black VENUM waistband (Dec 2025 and Jun 2026 cutouts, UFC Vegas 119); red wrist tape at UFC Vegas 119 (red corner).

stance_and_guard.observed: UFC Vegas 119 (Jun 2026): blocking a high kick with both gloves up at the temples, elbows tight to the head, chin down and shoulders hunched; throwing a lead right hook from southpaw with his head on the centre line.
stance_and_guard.arms_note: Thick arms; when covering, the forearms frame the face vertically.
stance_and_guard.style: Southpaw power striker and counter-puncher, often a slow starter (data/scouting/manel-kape.json)
stance_and_guard.confidence: medium-low: two action frames plus the scouting file

render_hints.skin_base: middleage_african_male (#66402a): the closest swatch to tone_hex_recommended #85513e, though a little darker; the avatar tint can only darken, so if the renderer allows, lift this skin slightly toward #85513e. Texture picked by age and swatch colour only.
render_hints.hair: cornrow pattern needs a scalp texture or normal map (no proxy fits); short black strands on top, shaved sides, small knot at the crown

ethnicity_fit.basis: Fitted by eye to how MakeHuman's three shape bases reproduce what the photos show: a broad nose with wide, flared nostrils and a low-to-medium bridge, full upper and lower lips, and a tall rounded forehead. Not assigned from name or nationality.
ethnicity_fit.confidence: low-to-medium: check a render against the ESPN headshot and the Jun 2026 profile; the detail morphs below are kept moderate so the sheet still works if this block is removed

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set; not in the shipped manifest.

morphs_unavailable: No target for the cornrows (texture/normal map on a shaved-scalp base) or the beard edge shape; the tall forehead is only approximated by forehead-scale-vert.
notes: Confidence: high for hair (cornrows to a crown knot, shaved sides), beard, skin depth, absence of tattoos and the thick compact build; medium for face proportions; medium for morph values. Few recent calm photos: the 2026 face views are studio cutouts and fight frames. Watch for: (1) recognition cues are the tall rounded forehead under the cornrows, the dense short full beard, the broad flared nose and full lips; (2) he is the only southpaw of the four: mirror the stance, lead with the right side; (3) build is thick and broad-chested; do not give him a lean, shredded flyweight torso; (4) skin is the deepest of the group; the closest skin swatch is a touch darker than the sampled tone; (5) macro/heightDownM uses heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 = -0.31 (research/assets.md), same as Van and Pantoja at 165 cm; measure the mesh and nudge it to 165 cm. ageOldM 0.123 follows avatar3d.js (33.0 - 25) / 65. The ethnicity_fit block is opt-in for avatar3d.js; drop it if the orchestrator wants the neutral thirds kept.
